title: Conditional probability and the law of total probability
dek: P(A | B) reweights A to the world where B occurred. Bayes’ identity is this definition plus a swap of labels. Neither is a posterior until you name the prior event.
story: Once B has probability strictly greater than zero, the conditional probability of A given B is the fraction of B that also sits in A: P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B). You have not invented a new kind of uncertainty. You have renormalised the original measure onto the slice B.

The law of total probability is how you unslices. If {Bⱼ} is a partition of Ω, then P(A) = ∑ P(A | Bⱼ) P(Bⱼ). Diagnostic arithmetic is this sum: prevalence weights the sensitivity and the false-positive rate. Skipping the weights is how a 99% sensitive test is quoted as a 99% chance of disease.

Bayes’ theorem is the same definition with the intersection expanded the other way: P(B | A) = P(A | B) P(B)/P(A). The Wikipedia identity plate is the algebra. This plate is the construction you need before that identity means anything in a clinic or a parameter model.
deepTitle: Slices, partitions, and two cultures of B
deep: Independence is the special case P(A | B) = P(A), equivalently P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B). It is a modelling claim about the joint, not a default. Isolates from one household are the canonical counterexample.
The chain rule P(A ∩ B ∩ C) = P(A) P(B | A) P(C | A ∩ B) is how directed graphical models factor. Writing the product in the wrong order is a different joint.

Two different B’s: an observable event (test positive, smear 3+) versus a parameter set (θ in a region). Diagnostic Bayes conditions on a test. Parameter Bayes conditions on a likelihood function times a prior. Same identity, different σ-algebra.
P(B) = 0 makes the ratio undefined. Continuous parameters need densities and regular conditional distributions; do not divide by P(θ = 0.317) for a continuous prior.

Likelihood is not P(data | θ) as a number you add up over θ without a dominating measure. After data are observed, f(y | θ) as a function of θ is the likelihood function — own plate — which is not already P(θ | y).

formulas.label: Definition
formulas.note: Renormalise P onto the slice B.

formulas.label: Law of total probability
formulas.note: {Bⱼ} a partition. Diagnostic PPV uses this in the denominator of Bayes.

visual.caption: B slices the sample space. A ∩ B is the surviving piece of A. Dividing by P(B) is the mechanism. Bayes swaps which slice you condition on; the law of total probability rebuilds the marginal of A from a partition of B-like pieces.

example.title: Why PPV is not sensitivity
example.setup: Let D = disease, T+ = Ultra positive. Sensitivity P(T+ | D) = 0.90. Specificity P(T− | Dᶜ) = 0.98, so P(T+ | Dᶜ) = 0.02. Prevalence P(D) = 0.05 in this clinic.

steps.title: Build the marginal of T+
steps.body: P(T+) = 0.90×0.05 + 0.02×0.95 = 0.045 + 0.019 = 0.064. That is the law of total probability on the partition {D, Dᶜ}.

steps.title: Condition the other way
steps.body: P(D | T+) = P(T+ | D) P(D) / P(T+) = 0.045 / 0.064 ≈ 0.70. Sensitivity was 0.90; PPV is 0.70. The missing 0.20 is the false-positive mass from the 95% who are not diseased.

steps.title: Change the slice, change the number
steps.body: In a community screen with P(D) = 0.005 the same test has PPV ≈ 0.18. The likelihood ratio did not change. The prior event D did.

example.takeaway: Conditioning reverses only after you rebuild the marginal. Prevalence is that rebuild.

check.prompt: P(A | B) is best described as:
choices: The original probability renormalised to the slice B
check.answer: The original probability renormalised to the slice B
check.why: The definition is a ratio of two probabilities already licensed by the axioms. Bayes then swaps labels.

whyWrong.Always equal to P(B | A): That is the classic swap error; you need the two priors.
whyWrong.The p-value of A: A p-value is a tail under a null, a different object.

check.prompt: P(B) = 0.4, P(A ∩ B) = 0.1. What is P(A | B)?
On the mechanism map, the arrow into P(A) via partition is there because:
choices: Conditional probabilities cannot be used to recover a marginal
A partition plus P(A | Bⱼ) and P(Bⱼ) rebuilds the unconditional P(A) — the denominator Bayes will need
check.answer: A partition plus P(A | Bⱼ) and P(Bⱼ) rebuilds the unconditional P(A) — the denominator Bayes will need
check.why: Total probability is the rebuild step. Diagnostic PPV is the same rebuild with D versus not-D.

whyWrong.Conditional probabilities cannot be used: That is exactly what the law of total probability does.
